artworks.title: Hylocharis lactea (Sapphire-breasted Emerald)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This image shows two hummingbirds near a water lily in a pond. A serene scene is depicted with the hummingbirds perched delicately on thin stalks in the pond surrounded by water lilies and large green leaves. One bird has vibrant blue and green plumage with a hint of purple on its throat, while the other has its beak close to the water's surface, creating a reflection. Above them is a yellow and white water lily blossom, and in the background is a soft gradient sky blending with the silhouettes of vegetation. The style is reminiscent of John James Audubon's detailed illustrations of birds in their natural habitats.

artworks.title: Parra Sinensis (Pheasant-Tailed Jacana)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird known as "Parra Sinensis." It features intricate and long tail feathers, a yellow mark on its neck, and a red eye. The body is dark brown with white feather accents on the wings. The bird is perched on a lightly sketched terrain, highlighting its elongated toes. The style is reminiscent of a 19th-century ornithological illustration like those by John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Carpodacus erythrinus (Common Rose Finch)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds perched on a branch of a coniferous tree. The upper bird is rosy-colored with shades of red, while the lower bird is depicted in brown and white tones. They rest on a branch adorned with needle-like leaves and green cones characteristic of coniferous trees. The background is plain, accentuating the detail of the birds and the branch.

artworks.title: Disparate conocido (Well-Known Folly)
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure raising a sword and grabbing a person, while a crowd of onlookers react with fear and tension. The figures are sketched with fine lines and shadows, creating a dramatic atmosphere with strong contrasts between light and dark.

artworks.title: Disparate puntual (Sure Folly)
artworks.description: This is an image of a white horse with a rider on its back balancing on a tightrope. There is a crowd in the background watching the spectacle. The scene conveys tension and drama, with the precarious balance of horse and rider on the rope. The lines are rough and sketch-like.

artworks.title: Landscape with the Temptation of Christ
artworks.artist: Hieronymus Cock after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a woodland scene viewed from a slightly elevated angle. Two figures stand amidst a forest clearing, surrounded by large, twisted trees with lush canopies. The fine and detailed brushstrokes emphasize the textures of the tree bark, leaves, and ground. The forest continues into the distance, gradually thinning out to reveal an open landscape. The horizon is low, leading towards a distant view with small structures, water, a softly rendered sky with clouds, and birds in flight. The color palette consists of sepia tones, giving the image a warm, vintage appearance.

artworks.title: The Good Samaritan
artworks.artist: Jean-Marie Delatre and Simon Francois Ravenet I after William Hogarth
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Colonel Charles E. Hammond
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing various figures on a sloped terrain. A man is seated and injured, being tended to by another figure. There is a horse nearby and other figures in the distance. The landscape consists of hilly, wooded terrain, with a cloudy sky above. The image is monochromatic, using different shades of black and gray to emphasize details.

artworks.title: The Pool of Bethesda
artworks.artist: Simon Francois Ravenet I and Victor Marie Picot after William Hogarth
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Colonel Charles E. Hammond
artworks.description: The image depicts various figures arranged in a classical, narrative style. The central figure is standing near a pool, gesturing with one hand towards a group of people. Surrounding the central figure are other individuals engaged in different activities. To the left, several figures are gathered, displaying a range of poses and expressions. An angelic figure hovers above the scene with outstretched arms. The background shows an arched architectural structure with trees on either side. Text below the image details the title and credits of the artwork, stating "The Pool of Bethesda," painted by William Hogarth and engraved by Simon François Ravenet.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment Triptych
artworks.artist: attributed to Cornelis Cort after a follower Hieronymus Bosch
artworks.description: Printed with delicate black lines and shading on cream-white paper, three roughly continuous scenes packed with people and imaginary, nightmarish critters recreate the look of three panels in this horizontal engraving. The central panel is twice as wide as the side wings, and the panels are framed with borders with molding. In the left panel, a multi-tiered architectural structure with rows of arches and tracery floats on clouds in the upper half of that panel. Inside the structure, human-like figures sit or stand beneath arches and on balconies. Below, nude men and women as well as robed, winged angels gather or lounge in a garden-like setting that includes a tent, a boat on a winding river, and a fountain. The central panel depicts a chaotic and crowded battle scene. Piles of humans and fantastical creatures are engaged in conflict across rocky terrain. Winged angels, many with weapons, fight the demons. In the background, a cylindrical stone tower leans to the right. Smoke rises from distant fires, possibly out on a body of water. The people who are shown are often in contorted positions or reaching for help. The right panel continues the tumultuous imagery, but instead of battle, it depicts scenes of torment and disarray. Humans interact with strange, animal-like creatures and spinning wheels, cauldrons, and other oversized tools. A toad-like creature wearing a papal costume sits on a throne and oversees the scene near the center of this panel. People hang from gallows on the rocky terrain beyond. Two printed signatures appear in the printed images. In the lower left corner of the leftmost panel, an inscription reads, “HIERONYMVS BOS INVENTOR.” In the lower right of the central panel, text reads, “HIERONYMVS COCK EXCVDE.” Two lines of Latin text are printed below each panel. To the left, “IVSTORVM ANIMAE IN MANV DEI SVNT, NEC AT TINGET ILLOS CRVCIATVS.” Under the central panel, “TOLLITE O PORTAE CAPITA VESTRA AT TOLLIMINI FORES SEMPITERNAE VT INGREDIATVR REX ILLE GLORIOSVS.” And in the lower right, “IMPII ABITABVNTVR PRO COGITATIONIBVS SVIS, VT QVI A DNO DEFECERINT.”

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative stone urn atop a pedestal surrounded by lush foliage. The urn is covered in climbing plants that cascade down, partially obscuring the pedestal below. The scene is set against a backdrop of softly drawn trees and sky. The foreground features the title and text of "Les Soirées de Rome," accompanied by additional textual details. The overall composition reflects a harmonious blend of nature and classical decorative elements.

artworks.title: The Sarcophagus
artworks.description: The artwork shows an aerial view of an ancient monument with intricate relief carvings. In the background, a pyramid-like structure rises sharply. The etching technique features fine lines creating texture. Two figures in period costume converse near the monument, while another figure sits alone on a step. The color palette is sepia with tall trees to the right. The sky is filled with clouds.

artworks.title: The Statue before the Ruins
artworks.description: The image shows architectural ruins and surroundings from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is implied by the line of the architecture. An archway leads into a bright area. The lines are fine and detailed, capturing the texture of stone and foliage with precision. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of sepia and brown. There is a statue and a group of seated figures in the foreground, around architectural remnants. In the distance, two figures stand at the entrance of an archway. The archway and columns are overgrown with vegetation.

artworks.title: Steps to the Four Landmarks
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient temple on top of a set of steps. The artwork is detailed with fine lines showing the textures of the columns and vines. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia tones. Several figures are on the steps, with one pointing towards the temple. In the distance, there are tree silhouettes. The sky has softly rendered clouds.

artworks.title: The Ancient Temple
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting an architectural scene. The horizon is obscured by buildings, and the sky shows sketchy, swirling clouds. The main structure is an ancient-looking building with rounded Romanesque features, including columns and a curved facade. A bell and a cross are visible on the building. Two figures are at the base of a stone staircase, and a pile of branches or foliage is nearby. The etching has fine, expressive lines and a monochromatic color palette of brown ink on paper.

artworks.title: The Portrait Bust
artworks.description: This is an image of a classical sculpture in a garden. The image features a sculpted bust of a person on a pedestal surrounded by foliage and trees. Inscribed text below the bust reads "Les Soirées de Rome." The drawing showcases detailed leaves, branches, and the sculpture texture, with a color palette of earthy tones.

artworks.title: The Well
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a historical setting. A person is operating a well within a stone structure, drawing water using a pulley system. The foreground includes trees with intricate branches, and the sky is filled with soft, linear clouds. Fine line work and cross-hatching create texture in the foliage and structures. The color palette is sepia, giving an antique feel. Various items are scattered in the foreground, and in the distance, a building and more figures can be seen.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Arch
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a man standing on a stone ledge holding a long staff, looking up a path. Another figure in a robe is at the base of the ledge. Tall ruins of an ancient structure obscure the horizon. The ruins feature intricate ornate designs. In the distance, a sky with a few clouds is visible. The brushstrokes are detailed with fine hatching for texture and shadow. The color palette is sepia tones. The scene is framed by foliage on either side.

artworks.title: The Post
artworks.description: The image is portrayed from an elevated point of view in a detailed engraving style. The horizon line is implied by the tops of the trees and the architectural ruins in the distance. The central focus is a tall wooden structure with a pulley and lantern. Two figures, a man and a woman, stand to the right. The scene is characterized by fine, precise lines and a monochromatic color palette of varying shades of brown.

artworks.title: The Ancient Gallery
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of an interior viewed from an elevated perspective within a large, arched structure. The scene features a group of figures inside, with no prominent horizon visible. The etching style is intricate, depicting textures of stone, brickwork, and wooden beams using fine lines. The color scheme is monochromatic, contrasting dark and light areas for depth. Two figures are near the entrance, with one climbing rubble and the other standing. More figures are seen in discussion or exploring further in the background. Linear strokes define the inner walls and ceiling, enhancing the sense of historical grandeur.

artworks.title: The Triumph of David
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient military scene. The scene depicts a group of soldiers carrying a trophy, which appears to be a head mounted on spears, as they are surrounded by onlookers and other soldiers. To the left, a procession of cavalry and infantry with banners and musical instruments is visible, with one figure gesturing towards the central gathering. In the foreground, a man is kneeling with his arms raised in a gesture, while a dog stands nearby. The background contains a distant cityscape with towers and buildings under a cloudy sky. On the right, there is a mountainous area with trees, and some animals can be seen in a fenced area. The drawing is executed in a detailed, line-based style, using a sepia-toned wash to add shading and depth.

artworks.title: Antique Subject
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a pastoral scene with classical figures. In the center, a satyr is shown interacting with a goat. To the left, a figure is holding a garland, possibly a deity, accompanied by a putto or cherub-like being. On the right, a bust is mounted on a plinth next to a tree. The drawing is executed in fine lines and shading, typical of classical or neoclassical themes. The composition is enclosed in an oval frame.

artworks.title: Saint Eustace
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 35.4 x 26 cm (13 15/16 x 10 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunter, his horse, and several dogs in a forest landscape. The image shows an outdoor scene where a hunter kneels in front of a horse surrounded by dogs. In the background, there is a dense forest with tall trees, some with leaves and some bare. Nearby, a deer with large antlers stands amidst the trees, gazing towards the foreground. In the distance, a castle is perched atop a rocky hill enveloped by trees. The artwork features intricate lines and detailed textures common in works from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 11.3 x 8.2 cm (4 7/16 x 3 1/4 in.)
support: 23.3 x 21.2 cm (9 3/16 x 8 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing is a close-up view of a man's head and part of his neck. The man's head is turned to the right. He has a furrowed brow, a straight nose, a partially open mouth, and a thick, curly beard covering his lower face and chin. His hair is long and curly and seems to be flowing backward from his face. The drawing has been done in dark brown lines against plain, off-white paper.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 8 x 8.7 cm (3 1/8 x 3 7/16 in.)
support: 21.5 x 22.7 cm (8 7/16 x 8 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of a bearded man's head and shoulders in a slight left turn. The man has a detailed face with a prominent beard, curly hair, deep-set eyes, and a contemplative expression. He has a defined nose and a full head of hair framing his face. The man is wearing draped fabric around his shoulders or possibly a hood. The background is plain and neutral. The drawing style includes bold and fine lines, as well as shading for depth and texture.
